findings.issue: Intro called Meta's plunge 'the same growth-to-value repricing that gave PayPal its worst-ever day' — an unsupported characterization (no headline frames either as growth-to-value) that also merged the lead and the PayPal item into one narrative, against the four-distinct-narratives rule.
findings.resolution: Rewritten: PayPal's worst-ever day (n0860) is now the question already put to the fintech crowd, keeping the mega-cap/metaverse lead and the fintech capitulation item distinct.

findings.issue: Attention evidence rested only on metaverse-theme pieces (Snoop Dogg neighbour, metaverse real estate) and Meta's own disclosures; no retail-buying evidence was cited although an own-date Reuters retail-buying headline exists.
findings.resolution: Added Reuters n0782 ('Alphabet stock split may trigger retail buying, Dow inclusion') as the competing retail pull on the same night; no posts, counts or flows invented.

findings.issue: Third trigger was a generic rates caution plus a Bank of England sterling preview (n0107) unrelated to the Meta trade; the leverage risk the standard asks for was missing.
findings.resolution: Replaced with the card's TQQQ +21.35% five-session run into the print and the triple-leverage mechanism; n0107 removed. Rates now appear once in the section (AMD).

findings.issue: Paraphrase 'described Spotify ... as in an air pocket until its issues are addressed' shifted the subject of the Jefferies quote (headline: 'We're in an air pocket until we can address these issues with Spotify').
findings.resolution: Replaced with the exact headline wording as a quotation.

findings.issue: Hook 'the beat-and-raise that held its gains' overstated: CNBC n0642 reported +10% after hours, while the completed regular session was +5.12% to 122.76 USD.
findings.resolution: Hook changed to 'the beat-and-raise that survived the session'; note updated.

findings.resolution: Verified as material updates: each cites newly published own-date evidence of the completed outcome (PayPal n0860, n0857, n0859, n1156, n0858; Spotify results n1160, n1161, n0872, n1169) and a changed angle (trapdoor to capitulation; boycott to subscriber count).
